⭐ 1-Star Review – Bhanzu I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Bhanzu and feel that the money I spent was completely wasted. During the demo class, they showed an impressive method where children could perform multiple calculations mentally using their “stair method.” Based on the demo, I had high expectations and decided to enroll my son. However, after completing around 75 classes, I have seen almost no meaningful progress in his mental math skills. My son is currently in 7th grade in California and is enrolled in an accelerated math program, where he is working ahead of his grade level and covering 7th and 8th grade mathematics. Despite this, Bhanzu placed him in a batch with much younger/younger-grade students, as shown in the attached picture. I don't understand how this grouping is appropriate for a student at his level. Another major concern is the class size. Most of the time, there were around 4 students in a one-hour class. In practical terms, that means each student gets only about 15 minutes of individual attention, while we are paying a significant amount for the program. For the amount of money they charge, I expected structured teaching, appropriate placement based on the child's level, and meaningful individual attention. Unfortunately, I did not see that. In my opinion, parents would be much better off hiring a 1-on-1 math teacher from India, where you can often get personalized instruction at a fraction of the cost. I honestly feel that Bhanzu is more focused on enrolling students and making money than providing personalized learning based on each child's actual academic level. After 75 classes, I cannot justify the cost based on the progress my son has made. I would not recommend this program to other parents.
